problems.prompt: An athlete completes one round of a circular track of diameter 200 m in 40 s. What will be the distance covered and the displacement at the end of 2 minutes 20 s?
problems.attempt_hint: Pehle check karo ki 140s mein kitne rounds complete hue, uske baad bache hue rounds se displacement nikalo.

solution_steps.narration: Pehle find karte hain ki total rounds kitne lage.
Ek round ka distance circumference hota hai (2 * π * r).
Total distance ke liye 3.5 ko ek round ke distance se multiply karein.
Displacement ke liye dekhein ki 3 complete rounds me wapas starting point par aa gaya (displacement = 0). Aadha round (.5) use theek opposite end (diameter) par le jayega.

problems.prompt: Joseph jogs from one end A to the other end B of a straight 300 m road in 2 minutes 30 seconds and then turns around and jogs 100 m back to point C in another 1 minute. What are Joseph's average speeds and velocities from A to B and from A to C?
given: A to B: distance = 300 m, time = 150 s
B to C (back): distance = 100 m, time = 60 s
problems.attempt_hint: Average speed me sara distance add hoga, par average velocity me net displacement nikalna padega (A to C straight line distance).

solution_steps.narration: Part 1 (A to B): Straight line hai, toh distance aur displacement dono same hain (300 m). Time 150 s hai.
Part 2 (A to C): Total distance hoga A to B (300) plus B to C (100).
Total time A se C pahunchne me (A->B->C) laga time.
Average speed for A to C nikalein.
Displacement A se C ka straight shortcut hai. (300 gaya, 100 wapas aaya).
Average velocity for A to C nikalein using this displacement.

problems.answer: A to B: Speed 2 m/s, Vel 2 m/s. A to C: Speed 1.90 m/s, Vel 0.95 m/s

problems.prompt: A motorboat starting from rest on a lake accelerates in a straight line at a constant rate of 3.0 m/s^2 for 8.0 s. How far does the boat travel during this time?
problems.attempt_hint: Distance pucha hai aur final velocity di nahi gayi. Second equation of motion (s = ut + 1/2 at^2) sabse best fit hai.

solution_steps.narration: Second equation set karein. Kyunki u=0 hai, pehla term zero ho jayega.
Pehle time ka square calculate karein.
Ab values equation me solve karein.

problems.prompt: A driver of a car travelling at 52 km/h applies the brakes and accelerates uniformly in the opposite direction. The car stops in 5 s. Find the acceleration.
problems.attempt_hint: Formula me values daalne se pehle 52 km/h ko m/s me convert karna mat bhoolna (multiply by 5/18).

solution_steps.narration: Pehle u ko m/s me convert karein.
Acceleration ka basic formula lagayein.
Values put karein aur minus sign maintain rakhein.
Divide karein.

problems.prompt: A train is travelling at a speed of 90 km/h. Brakes are applied so as to produce a uniform acceleration of -0.5 m/s^2. Find how far the train will go before it is brought to rest.
problems.attempt_hint: Yahan time given nahi hai. The 'timeless equation' (2as = v^2 - u^2) use karna sabse direct tareeqa hoga.

solution_steps.narration: Pehle u ko m/s me convert karein.
Third equation of motion likhein aur knowns daalein.
Dono sides ko multiply aur square karein.
Minus signs dono side se cancel ho jayenge.

problems.prompt: An artificial satellite is moving in a circular orbit of radius 42250 km. Calculate its speed if it takes 24 hours to revolve around the earth.
problems.attempt_hint: Speed ka formula v = 2πr / T use karo. Answer ko km/s me lane ke liye 24 hours ko seconds me convert karna padega.

solution_steps.narration: Total distance ek revolution me circumference ke barabar hoti hai.
Total time (24 hours) ko seconds me convert karein (24 * 60 * 60).
Speed ke liye distance ko time se divide karein.
